title: Mall World College
content: I'm new to this Reddit, but I'm fascinated by Mall World. I was curious if anyone had been to Mall World College. I mainly visited the dorms; most rooms were filled to the brim with people, tight rooms filled with beds. I will say I was personally lucky to have only one roommate in my mallworld dorm room. The bathrooms/showers were all decrepit and falling apart. Has anyone been there?
